item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-09-17 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 10 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (3). Cisco has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2020-10987 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 724 positions.
